title: Retrieval-Augmented Text Generation Survey
summary: This community centers on a 2024 survey paper titled "A Survey on Retrieval-Augmented Text Generation for Large Language Models." The work is authored by Jimmy Huang and Yizheng Huang and was published on arXiv. It serves as a comprehensive review of methods that integrate retrieval mechanisms into text generation processes for large language models.
key_findings: The primary entity is a 2024 survey paper focused specifically on retrieval-augmented text generation for Large Language Models (LLMs).
